output.risk_rationale: Provisional medium risk as of 2026-11-09; not approved for onboarding. The bank is active and its corporate PSC and indirect natural-person controller are identified, but current OFAC SDN, UK and EU query results were not captured, so sanctions clearance remains outstanding. No adverse finding was established against this exact bank in the reviewed material; fines and litigation involving other Revolut companies are not attributed to it. A director’s former civic office and the controlling owner’s reported family connection require proportionate PEP review, not an automatic designation. Primary-source LEI verification and several officer nationalities remain incomplete. These gaps warrant enhanced due diligence before a final risk decision.

lei_verification.note: An opened third-party publication of GLEIF data reports this LEI and GB jurisdiction. The official GLEIF page did not render record fields; the API record could not be retrieved. Registration LEI and jurisdiction are therefore left null under the requested primary-source requirement.
